Project Overview

This is an R package called riemstats that implements various Riemannian ANOVA statistics. The package is designed for statistical analysis on Riemannian manifolds.

Development Commands

Building and Installation

# Install development version
devtools::install()

# Build package
devtools::build()

# Load package for development
devtools::load_all()

# Document package (generates man pages from roxygen comments)
devtools::document()

Testing

# Run all tests
devtools::test()

# Run tests with coverage
covr::package_coverage()

# Run specific test file
testthat::test_file("tests/testthat/tests.R")

Checking and Linting

# Run R CMD check
devtools::check()

# Check examples
devtools::run_examples()

# Check vignettes
devtools::build_vignettes()

Package Website

# Build pkgdown site locally
pkgdown::build_site()

# Preview site
pkgdown::preview_site()

Code Architecture

Core Functions

The package provides statistical functions for Riemannian ANOVA analysis, organized in R/:

  • riem_anova.R: Core ANOVA statistics including:
    • log_wilks_lambda(): Computes log Wilks’ lambda statistic
    • pillais_trace(): Computes Pillai’s trace statistic
    • riem_anova(): Main ANOVA function for Riemannian data
  • frechet_anova.R: Implements Fréchet ANOVA methods
    • frechet_anova(): ANOVA using Fréchet means
  • honnorat.R: Contains harmonization and normalization functions
    • combat_harmonization(): ComBat harmonization for batch effects
    • rigid_harmonization(): Rigid alignment harmonization
    • normalization(): Data normalization utilities

Key Dependencies

  • Matrix: For matrix operations and determinants
  • CovTools: For covariance matrix tools
  • sva: For ComBat batch effect correction
  • riemtan: Related package for Riemannian tangent space operations

CSuperSample Class

The package works with CSuperSample objects (from the riemtan package) which represent collections of data on Riemannian manifolds. These objects have methods for computing within-group ($compute_W()) and total ($compute_T()) covariance matrices.

Testing Structure

Tests are in tests/testthat/tests.R and use the testthat framework. All new functions should have corresponding test cases.

Documentation

  • Function documentation uses roxygen2 format in source files
  • Package documentation website is built with pkgdown at https://nicoesve.github.io/riemstats/
  • Vignettes in vignettes/ provide detailed usage examples
